name: checks.list
title: List the checks
description: Lists the checks of the books the person asking may see, with books health: each check's key, area, what it checks, its latest status (ok, warning, error, due, not_assessed or failed) and how many items it found. Use checks.explain for one check's items.

area.description: Only this area's checks, as a check's area reads, such as Books or Bank.

status.description: Only the checks whose latest run found this.
